annotations.text:
Balast /pools — three directions, same live data (14 Sep), 1280 CSS px = a 1920 display at 150%.
A Vault: dark, serif headline, big rows, one wide market list. Trade-off: fewer rows on screen.
B Ledger: warm paper, light. Trade-off: breaks the dark brand; needs a real light palette pass.
C Terminal Pro: current DNA, denser, two boards side by side. Trade-off: reads as a tool, not a product.
Token marks are placeholders — real logos slot in the same discs.
